description: The ownership gap is insider ownership minus institutional ownership, keeping the sign.

c.request: For each nearby corporate event type (`corpeventprx`) in the sentiment and fundamentals snapshots, with snapshots that have no event type as their own group, what is the average number of analyst coverage reports (`anlycount`), and what is the average gap between insider ownership (`inholdpct`) and institutional ownership (`instownpct`)? Also show each event type's average gap minus the plain average of all the event types' average gaps; this last value can be negative. Averages ignore missing values. Return nothing if that overall average is missing, and don't round anything. The ownership gap is insider ownership minus institutional ownership, keeping the sign.
c.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_ownership_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ownership_gap) AS overall_avg_gap FROM g) SELECT g.corpeventprx, g.avg_anlycount, g.avg_ownership_gap, g.avg_ownership_gap - o.overall_avg_gap AS gap_minus_overall_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall_avg_gap IS NOT NULL

b.request: For each distinct `corpeventprx` value in `sentimentandfundamentals` (with NULL event type as its own group), compute the average `anlycount`, the average of (`inholdpct` − `instownpct`) as a signed gap, and that average gap minus the unweighted mean of all groups' average gaps, ignoring NULLs in averages, returning no rows if the overall mean of group average gaps is NULL, with no rounding
b.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gap) AS mean_gap FROM g) SELECT g.corpeventprx, g.avg_anlycount, g.avg_gap, g.avg_gap - m.mean_gap AS gap_minus_mean FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_gap IS NOT NULL

a.request: For each nearby corporate event type (`corpeventprx`) in the sentiment and fundamentals snapshots, with snapshots that have no event type as their own group, show the event type, the average number of analyst coverage reports (`anlycount`), and the average of insider ownership minus institutional ownership (`inholdpct` − `instownpct`). Keep the sign of that difference, so it is negative when institutional ownership is higher. Also show the event type's average difference minus the plain average of all the event types' average differences; this last value can be negative. Averages ignore missing values. Return nothing if that overall average is missing, and don't round anything.
a.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_ownership_diff FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ownership_diff) AS overall_avg_diff FROM g) SELECT g.corpeventprx, g.avg_anlycount, g.avg_ownership_diff, g.avg_ownership_diff - o.overall_avg_diff AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall_avg_diff IS NOT NULL

d.request: For each nearby corporate event type (`corpeventprx`) in the sentiment and fundamentals snapshots, with snapshots that have no event type forming their own group, what is the average number of analyst coverage reports (`anlycount`), and what is the average ownership gap, defined as insider ownership (`inholdpct`) minus institutional ownership (`instownpct`), keeping the sign so it can be negative? Also show each event type's average gap minus the plain (unweighted) average of all the event types' average gaps, which can also be negative. Averages ignore missing values. Return nothing if that overall average gap is missing, and don't round anything.
d.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT corpeventprx AS ev, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anly, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gap) AS overall_gap FROM g) SELECT g.ev AS corpeventprx, g.avg_anly AS avg_anlycount, g.avg_gap AS avg_ownership_gap, g.avg_gap - o.overall_gap AS gap_minus_overall_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall_gap IS NOT NULL
